title: Curcuma longa tincture for medicinal use
intro: Curcuma longa tincture is a concentrated liquid extract made from the rhizomes of the turmeric plant, which is native to South Asia. It is prepared by soaking the dried rhizomes in alcohol to extract the active compounds, particularly curcumin. In herbalism, this tincture is valued for its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and analgesic properties. It is commonly used to support joint health, reduce inflammation, and aid in digestion. This preparation is often taken internally in small doses or applied topically for skin conditions and pain relief.
